campaign_purpose: Measure calibration factor C(f, beta) = lambda_frag / lambda_MJ at intermediate supercriticality (f = 1.3-2.0) to constrain extrapolation uncertainty from near-critical to HGBS-relevant regimes
peer_review_issue: Field-geometry calibration extrapolation is not adequately constrained

classification_criteria.FRAG: Longitudinal beading detected with measurable wavelength
classification_criteria.RADIAL_COLLAPSE: Radial collapse dominates without longitudinal structure
classification_criteria.detection_method: HST peak-to-peak + FFT power spectrum + visual inspection

deliverables.C_f_beta_table: Calibration factor as function of f and beta
deliverables.uncertainty_quantification: Standard error on C across beta values and seeds
deliverables.extrapolation_analysis: Test of constancy hypothesis C = constant vs C(f)

success_criteria.minimum: At least 50% FRAG rate with C measured for 3+ f values at beta = 0.3
success_criteria.full: 75%+ FRAG rate with complete C(f, beta) table for all 6x3 combinations
